description: This file provides helper functions for interacting with Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) over WebSocket, including URL validation, URL manipulation, WebSocket connection management, and HTTP request handling.

classes.name: CdpResponse
classes.description: Type representing a response from CDP with id, result, and error fields.

classes.name: Pending
classes.description: Type representing a pending promise with resolve and reject functions.

methods.name: isWebSocketUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL uses WebSocket protocol (ws or wss).

methods.name: assertCdpEndpointAllowed
methods.description: Validates if a CDP URL is allowed based on SSRF policy.

methods.name: redactCdpUrl
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from a CDP URL.

methods.name: getHeadersWithAuth
methods.description: Generates headers with Basic auth if URL contains username or password.

methods.name: appendCdpPath
methods.description: Appends a path to a CDP URL.

methods.name: normalizeCdpHttpBaseForJsonEndpoints
methods.description: Normalizes CDP URL for JSON endpoints by adjusting protocol and path.

methods.name: createCdpSender
methods.description: Creates a sender object for communicating with CDP over WebSocket.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with timeout.

methods.name: fetchCdpChecked
methods.description: Performs a fetch with timeout and error handling for CDP.

methods.name: fetchOk
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to check if URL is accessible.

methods.name: openCdpWebSocket
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection to a CDP endpoint with optional headers and timeout.

methods.name: withCdpSocket
methods.description: Manages WebSocket connection lifecycle to perform operations with CDP.
